description:
Datalastic helps you track vessels, explore ports, and research maritime activity using natural language. Find current ship positions and historical AIS tracks, check destinations and estimated arrival times, and search for vessels by name, flag, type, size, or location.
Explore global ports and terminals, including UN/LOCODEs, operators, and coordinates. Look up vessel specifications, tonnage, cargo capacity, engine details, and propulsion systems. Check marine weather, waves, swell, currents, and seven-day forecasts around a vessel, port, or location.
Research vessel ownership and management, Port State Control inspections, detentions, casualties, dry-dock schedules, classification, and sale-and-purchase records. Estimate sea route distances and generate downloadable maritime data reports.
Requires an active Datalastic subscription.
